versions.changelog:
Initial release of vidunderstand: instantly convert video or audio (link or file) to clean, ready-to-use text, supporting summarization and content rewriting.

- Upload a video or audio (local file or link), receive a processed transcript with filler words and errors removed.
- Supports both direct transcription and customizable prompts for new content formats (e.g., Xiaohongshu/Douyin copywriting, meeting minutes, key quotes, scripts, or translations).
- Can extract subtitles, summarize videos, and generate content in multiple writing styles as requested.
- Easy command-line usage; requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN to run.
- Automatically filters out background noise and speech disfluencies for professional-quality output.
